headline: A law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Youngstown, Ohio, after Carl Nunziato.
what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Youngstown, Ohio, the Carl Nunziato VA Clinic. It does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or hours. The change is only a new official name.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021.
